name: First Heaven
overview: The First Heaven, as depicted in Scripture, refers to the original created heavens that God formed at the beginning, over the formless earth where His Spirit moved (Genesis 1:2). This heaven, along with the first earth, will ultimately pass away, making way for the new heaven and new earth promised in Revelation 21:1. Christ’s promise to prepare a place for believers (John 14:3) points to a future dwelling beyond the first heaven. The final judgment scene in Revelation 20:11 reveals the departure of the old heaven and earth, emphasizing God's sovereign renewal. The river of life flowing from God's throne (Revelation 22:1) symbolizes the eternal life and purity of the new creation that follows the passing of the first heaven.
